summary: The Hammer Trial of Brell’s Forge is the divine crucible where molten rivers fuel colossal forges. Brell’s craftsmanship echoes through the halls, guarded by stone guardians and flame‑born titans.
history: Forged by Brell Serilis as the heart of Underfoot.
Magma rivers were channeled into controlled flows.
Stone guardians were shaped by divine hammers.
Collapse pressure fractured the forge halls.
The Forge Titan manifested as embodiment of Brell’s craftsmanship.
